- [ASSISTANT_SAID] HHN usually takes place on select nights in September and October, running from around 7 pm to 1 am or 2 am.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The main attractions of HHN include immersive mazes, scare zones, live shows, and themed food and beverages.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Scare zones are areas where roaming scareactors try to scare guests, themed around horror franchises or original concepts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tickets can be general admission or VIP experiences, such as the Express Pass or VIP Behind-the-Screams Tour.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for attending include arriving early, planning a route, dressing comfortably, and not going alone.
